extracted.intended_audience: Yale communications staff, campus unit communicators, and members of the media
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for producing and distributing Yale communications (press releases, videos, internal messaging) that reflect the university's brand, voice, and crisis procedures. Emphasizes aligning copy, visuals, and outreach with Yale's identity and OPAC processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Our mission
rubrics_metrics.description: As storytellers and ambassadors, the Office of Public Affairs & Communications informs and inspires local and global audiences while stewarding the university’s reputation and voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should inform and inspire audiences and protect/steward Yale's reputation; authors should adopt a storyteller/ambassador mindset when crafting messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: For the media
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting on Yale? We can help you meet all your print, broadcast, and online media needs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing materials for external press, coordinate with the Office to ensure accuracy, appropriate materials for print/broadcast/online formats, and adherence to media relations processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: For the Yale community
rubrics_metrics.description: Communicate your campus unit’s vital work and research with these Yale tools and services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use provided Yale tools and services to share research and unit news internally and with campus audiences; follow established channels rather than ad hoc distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience Insights
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor messages based on audience insights — identify target audiences and adapt tone, channels, and content accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications Consulting and Community
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Seek consulting and community support within OPAC for strategy, planning, and peer feedback on communications projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital & Brand Strategy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align digital content and distribution with Yale’s brand strategy and digital best practices to maintain consistency across platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow editorial standards (accuracy, clarity, appropriate tone) and use OPAC editorial resources for drafting and reviewing copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Communications
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate internal messaging through OPAC channels and follow internal-communication best practices to reach campus audiences effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Relations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with Media Relations for interview coordination, embargoes, spokesperson preparation, and managing press inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Office of the University Printer
rubrics_metrics.description: Office of the University Printer (office resource/area)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For printed materials, use the University Printer to ensure consistency with Yale production standards and identity guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operations, Project Management & Program Planning
rubrics_metrics.description: Operations, Project Management & Program Planning (office resource/area)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use OPAC operations and project management services for planning, timelines, approvals, and logistics of communications projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yale Visitor Center
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate visitor-facing communications and materials with the Visitor Center when relevant to public events or tours.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yale Identity
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to Yale Identity visual and brand standards (logos, typography, colors) when producing press materials and collateral.

rubrics_metrics.name: Campus Photos
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use approved campus photography resources for imagery in stories and press releases to ensure quality and rights compliance.

rubrics_metrics.name: OPAC Style Guide
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the OPAC Style Guide for writing conventions, tone, usage, and editorial policies when drafting public-facing copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Video guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow video production and publishing guidelines for storytelling through video — technical specs, branding, and editorial considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yale Verbal Identity Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply Yale’s verbal identity — voice, tone, messaging pillars, and approved terminology — in headlines, leads, and body text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Crisis Playbook
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In a crisis or sensitive situation, follow the Crisis Playbook procedures for approvals, spokesperson coordination, messaging, and timing.
